COM-MAINT.evidence: Inconsistent with project conventions: no re-runnable decrypt or extraction script was saved in /app; all decryption and data export were executed via ad-hoc inline 'python3 -c' commands ([17], [27]), leaving no scripts for maintainability.

C7-04-S1.evidence: In action [1], the agent ran 'sqlite3 main.db' without read-only mode or making a backup first, causing SQLite to delete /app/main.db-wal ([2], [3]). The agent had to restore the WAL file from an environment backup in /tmp ([7], [10]).
